prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic avant-garde portrait against an absolute black studio void, emphasizing tactile biomimetic couture and sculptural headwear.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with downward serene gaze, natural pores and vellus hair, wearing a fully covered high-neck second-skin couture suit of teal, oxidized copper, and burnt-orange mosaic scales, with arms raised comfortably behind the head; white translucent spun-fiber headpiece inspired by frozen smoke, not a branded designer replica.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 centered symmetrical upper-body portrait at eye level, black non-reflective void, shoulders and arms visible, face isolated against darkness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Single snooted 5600K spotlight on face, subtle cool rim light on headpiece and scales, negative fill, deep crushed blacks, no neon.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 120mm macro at f/8, Kodak Ektar 100 film simulation, rich deep colors, fine grain, sharp facial texture and garment scales.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic avant-garde fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman in a fully covered high-neck biomimetic couture suit made of teal, oxidized copper, and burnt-orange mosaic scales, serene downward gaze, arms raised comfortably behind her head, sculptural white translucent spun-fiber headpiece inspired by frozen smoke, pitch-black non-reflective studio void, snooted 5600K spotlight, cool rim light, deep chiaroscuro, Hasselblad H6D-100c 120mm macro, Kodak Ektar 100 grain, 4:5, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, restraint, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, branded designer replica, neon, plastic skin, CGI, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: biomimetic couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the iridescent scale construction, raised-arm silhouette, white sculptural headpiece, black void, and dramatic lighting; keep the adult fictional identity and materials replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the surreal couture concept, full coverage, texture, and lighting. Keep identity, materials, and setting details replaceable; do not reproduce a real designer or public figure likeness.

policy_review.changes: Specified a clearly adult fictional subject, fully covered high-neck couture, comfortable pose, and generic headpiece without named designer styling.
policy_review.notes: Surreal fashion styling is non-graphic and nonsexual.
